title: S4-EXPORT-13 — A lighthouse for a pocket-sized drawing.
goal: Light Sweep is its own export: it describes a 540 x 960 phone video at 12 frames a second, and saving it either announces the saved video or is honestly refused; the drawing stays exact.

steps.text: MP4 where your browser can make it, otherwise WebM.

steps.say: Either the status reads "Light Sweep saved.", or Save video is disabled, or a clear failure message is shown.

cliOnly: decoding the delivered clip: the lamp position changes over time and animated drawings keep playing (tests/production/lightSweep.spec.ts)
